findings.desc: Renamed @lattice packages still encode stale 0.3.1 cross-dependencies that do not resolve under the new scope. packages/main depends on @lattice/lab@0.3.1, while lab/utils depend on @lattice/core@0.3.1 even though core is 0.3.65. Dry-run installs fail with E404/ETARGET for @lattice/lab@0.3.1 and @lattice/core@0.3.1, but scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs versions passes because EXPECTED_EXTENSION_VERSION is hard-coded to 0.3.1. This leaves install/publish metadata broken and the verifier blessing the stale manual lock/manifest edits.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit ca6818920: @lattice/core, @lattice/utils, and @lattice/lab now share version 0.3.65; inter-package deps use @lattice/core@0.3.65 and @lattice/lab@0.3.65; packages/main/lab/utils package-lock dry-run installs pass; verify-global-lab-entrypoint now expects 0.3.65.

findings.desc: Current CHK-004 Codex adapter verification is not re-attestable after the merge: `node bin/lattice.js verify_codex` exits 1 with hard failure `global-fallback-heartbeat`, and `node scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs` exits 1 on the same assertion (`global fallback heartbeat should override inherited local-wrapper entrypoint`). The printed fallback heartbeat command itself succeeds when run directly but takes about 20s; `runCodexAdapterChecks` uses a 10s default timeout, so the authoritative verify command times out its embedded session_brief heartbeat. Because CHK-004 evidence explicitly depended on `lattice verify_codex && node scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs`, test-coverage cannot mark B-3523 clean until this verification path passes or the evidence is updated with an intentional waiver. Package dry-runs, validate, done_required, quorum status, runtime fact/entrypoint/global-lab/koala-residue checks, and experiments/recovery-runner unrelatedness all passed; this finding is limited to the current Codex adapter verification failure.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit e501cd61b: Codex adapter heartbeat defaults are split so the local wrapper remains 10s while global fallback heartbeat gets a 30s default; explicit timeoutMs still overrides both. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node bin/lattice.js verify_codex, node scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs, node scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs, and node scripts/verify-runtime-fact-contract.mjs.
